target_customer: Hearing-impaired adults with hearing loss who struggle in noisy social settings, reached via hearing aid buyers and audiologists
problem: Hearing aids amplify all sound, so speech is hard to follow in restaurants and gatherings, which the company called the biggest unmet need in hearing healthcare.
business_model: Hardware hearing aid sold to patients (device sales); no pricing found
product_category: ML-enhanced hearing aids with custom microphone arrays

founders.name: Shariq Mobin
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a machine learning and distributed systems hacker and accessibility advocate; named as sole inventor on a patent granted to AudioFocus Inc in March 2024 per a directory listing. Co-founder, a hearing aid hardware design expert, is not named in sources found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed real-time source separation by distance with acoustics-informed ML on a tiny low-power device plus custom microphone array hardware, which major hearing aid makers had struggled with for years.

defensibility.rationale: A patent was later granted (March 2024), and the combined ML and array design is hard, but incumbents had far larger R&D and distribution through audiologists.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents and well funded startups later shipped deep learning noise reduction in hearing aids (for example Whisper in 2020 and Starkey and Oticon AI features), absorbing the wedge. No evidence AudioFocus shipped a product.

market_need_then: YC copy cites 37M US adults with hearing loss of whom 8M use hearing aids, and noisy places as the top complaint; consistent with industry surveys of hearing aid dissatisfaction, but not independently verified here.

branding.domain_note: audiofocus.io, not the .com; website returned HTTP 503 when fetched.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain mission copy about human connection for the hearing impaired

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand coverage found; name resembles SoundFocus, an earlier hearing startup, and search results mixed them up.

outcome_analysis: AudioFocus entered YC in Summer 2019 with an ambitious ML and microphone array hearing aid for noisy rooms. The YC directory lists it as Inactive, but no shutdown announcement, post-mortem or acquisition was found, so the cause is not public. Failure factors are inferences from the difficulty of the hardware and the arrival of funded rivals such as Whisper in 2020, and are low confidence.
notes: Directory status Inactive, but one search summary of a YC listing said Active and a patent was granted in March 2024; status conflict unresolved. An aggregator (bouncewatch) lists a YC seed on 2019-08-22 with unknown amount, unverified so not recorded as a round. No competitor sources dated near mid 2019 were found; Whisper's coverage is from 2020 so it is excluded from the competitor list.
